title: Speed of Thought: AI Meetup
description: WeMakeDevs brings AI builders and professionals together at 91Springboard, 21B Udyog Vihar, Sector 18, Gurugram for a day of learning, building and meeting people: a workshop on how Wispr Flow makes writing and working by voice feel natural, a tech talk on model quantization for efficient inference, then an open build phase with judging. Prizes for the best build and the best social post. Pizza and drinks provided.
price: Free — registration subject to host approval, capacity 100
data_gaps: Ticket price not published; entry is by host approval.
